    Navigate to the Product Views report, set the date range to
    07/05/2021 - 05/31/2023, and trigger report generation.
    """
    # 1) Navigate to the canonical Product Views report page (relative URL)
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/report/product/viewed/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    # 2) Prefer explicit 'From' and 'To' textboxes by accessible name
    from_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='From')
    to_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='To')

    # Fill named controls if present (defensive count checks)
    if await from_box.count() > 0:
        await from_box.nth(0).fill('07/05/2021')
    if await to_box.count() > 0:
        await to_box.nth(0).fill('05/31/2023')

    # 2b) Fallback: use the first two textboxes on the page if named ones aren't present
    textboxes = page.get_by_role('textbox')
    n_textboxes = await textboxes.count()
    if n_textboxes >= 2:
        if await from_box.count() == 0:
            await textboxes.nth(0).fill('07/05/2021')
        if await to_box.count() == 0:
            await textboxes.nth(1).fill('05/31/2023')
    elif n_textboxes == 1:
        # Some UIs combine the range into a single control; attempt a conservative combined fill
        if await from_box.count() == 0 and await to_box.count() == 0:
            try:
                await textboxes.nth(0).fill('07/05/2021 - 05/31/2023')
            except Exception:
                # Narrowly ignore if combined fill doesn't apply
                pass

    # 3) Trigger the report generation. Scope the click to the form that contains the date controls when possible.
    clicked = False

    # Scope to a form that has the 'From' textbox to avoid ambiguous button clicks
    form_with_from = page.get_by_role('form').filter(has=page.get_by_role('textbox', name='From'))
    if await form_with_from.count() > 0:
        form = form_with_from.nth(0)
        # Try common button names inside this scoped form in preferred order
        for btn_name in ('Show Report', 'Show', 'Refresh'):
            btn = form.get_by_role('button', name=btn_name)
            if await btn.count() > 0:
                await btn.nth(0).click()
                clicked = True
                break
        # If no named button found, click the first button in the form as a fallback
        if not clicked:
            buttons = form.get_by_role('button')
            if await buttons.count() > 0:
                await buttons.nth(0).click()
                clicked = True

    # 3b) Page-level fallback: try common button names if form-scoped attempts didn't click anything
    if not clicked:
        for btn_name in ('Show Report', 'Show', 'Refresh'):
            btn = page.get_by_role('button', name=btn_name)
            if await btn.count() > 0:
                await btn.nth(0).click()
                clicked = True
                break

    # 3c) Final fallback: submit an enclosing form that contains any textbox
    if not clicked:
        forms = page.get_by_role('form')
        if await forms.count() > 0:
            c = await forms.count()
            for i in range(c):
                frm = forms.nth(i)
                if await frm.get_by_role('textbox').count() > 0:
                    form_handle = await frm.element_handle()
                    if form_handle is not None:
                        await page.evaluate('(f) => f.submit()', form_handle)
                        clicked = True
                        break

    # 4) Wait briefly for the report to render/update
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
